notes.title: Astral Vangard Official Launch v1.00
notes.content:
Astral Vangard Official Launch Version 1.00

Hi Vangards, I'm happy to announce the official launch of Astral Vangard with new content and updates to the game. Thanks to all of you.


Sound Effects:


In this new launch version of Astral Vanguard, sound effects have been introduced to all Vangard Weapons and new Explosions sound effects. To make the gaming experience more immersive and engaging. And more newsound effects for menu UI and in game.


New Game Camera an UI and more Enemies :

The camera's viewing range has been expanded, so there can now be more enemies on the screen, making operations even more treacherous. The UI has also been adjusted accordingly with the new game view.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/c75b99b07bc69097df221aceb9e4a8386e69efae.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/6177cc338d8c0a4a9032c1567616e72408825960.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/b7b76bd25bcdae1bea5e05300a383e20ca85f4fb.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/b89283364616004aac62807d3a9f58385d4d5bc5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/6c2c6e4fecbb581c3329255d40853dbe0219b439.png


New Game Mode:

A new game mode has been introduced, the "Challenge Operation". These are special operations that start at level 1, once the current level is completed a next level will unlock and the enemies will be increasingly stronger. Each level will be completely random with a random map and enemies so to have a lot of variety even by choosing the same operation you will be able to find a different map and enemies and even the boss. The Challenge Operation is unlocked once the Normal Operations are completed. Test yourself in this new mode and face increasingly stronger enemies, how many operations can you complete? Beat your record and unlock the next level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/49e713e46efe953b8f64d9388ee660eb86ce39b3.png


New Map Tylos:

Players who take on the challenges in the new mode will find a new exclusive map when starting the operation (This Map is only in the Challenge Operation mode).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/5089c64c68b8d0ceb93076b8acdfd0f04bc278b2.png

New Enemies in Challenge Mode

With the new mode, new enemies have been introduced that you will find in the Challenge Operation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/a7a2009a2e958b09751e93a45b08c76d9255952c.png


New Weapon Astral Light Sword

New Weapon added to Cosmic Forge, Astral Light Sword.

Players can Forge the new Weapon Astral Light Sword in Hangar-Cosmic Forge for 1000 minerals.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/90b2f67bd60616f4c6fd0823433428e670cccbbf.png


 Astral Light Sword Lv 1: A short-range power Light Sowrd attack that hits all enemies in its radius. Damage (200), Cooldown (4s).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/3316acb619de871ebf62aca21bb01b12cd7897b7.png

 Astral Light Sword Lv 2: Increase the damage of Energy Light Sword and radius range.
Damage (250), Cooldown (4s).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/dc1eaf07999f51a390cb034c335f5a293301d257.png

 Astral Light Sword Lv 3: Increase at the max damage of Energy Light Sword and radius range.
 Damage (300), Cooldown (4s).

notes.title: Astral Vangard Update v0.80 (08/04)
notes.content:
Added to all Vangard (Player) a new animation. Each individual Vangard has had its own movement animation added to the game.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/464a7262f456a1be7c1c9fa0dfcef3e5e2287cf6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/afe46ef49fc6e27c124e30283603bb065eb081cd.png



A new Vangard is arrive, Astrion.

Player can unlock the new Vangard Astrion. for 2000 minerals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/d96dde6a8dc5f1533d80630a8440f478c79f124e.png

Astrion primary weapon is Lightning Shock:


 Lightning Shock Lv 1: Lightning impulse that hits all enemies in range with high rate of fire andlow speed. Damage (30), Cooldown (0.5s).

 Lightning Shock Lv 2: Increase Lightning Shock damage and rate of fire.
 Damage (45), Cooldown (0.4s).

 Lightning Shock Lv 3: Increase Lightning Shock at max damage and rate of fire.
Damage (70), Cooldown (0.3s).


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/a6f43639ae790b8347d5c0264959e9d918bf6687.png


New Weapon added to Cosmic Forge, Phoenix Strike.

Player can Forge the new Weapon Phoenix Strike in Hangar-Cosmic Forge for 1000 minerals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/25f9137307fd033b6b8c32ecf7f38d0147f4f331.png


 Phoenix Strike Lv 1: A phoenix attack that descends and flies towards enemies at medium speed. Damage (100), Cooldown (3.5s).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/a70bac9765e9bcb7a3aae41f573be49f93dc41fb.png


 Phoenix Strike Lv 2: Increases damage and reduces its cooldown.
Damage (150), Cooldown (2.5s).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44881452/9bd36cd948f28f45ec85204d65718471b35a2270.png


 Phoenix Strike Lv 3: Fires 2 Shoenix Strike and increase at max the damage and reduce its cooldown.
 Damage (200), Cooldown (1.5s).

notes.title: Update Notes v0.77 (23/03)
notes.content:
Bug Fix

 Fixed bug at the beginning of the map level the game was paused.
 Fixed bug where the game did not pause if the controller connected during the game was disconnected.



End of Tribute to Akira Toriyama.


 Remove the limited time all "Vangard" will release their power in a ki energy aura.
 Remove the  limited time "Enemy Soldier" become "Slime Soldier ". Enemy Soldier return to the original design.
